scripts.format:dart: cd apps/mobile && dart format lib test
scripts.gen:dart-client: pnpm --filter @bida/api-contract openapi && cd packages/api-client-dart && rm -rf lib/src && dart run swagger_parser && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && dart format lib
